result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

The fix is one added condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I also added a line to its Javadoc saying cancelled purchase orders are left out.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged (highest count first, then name and id).

I ran the tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` and they pass. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example, and I didn't run the full test suite.
